en.summary: 404 Media’s Jason Koebler rounds up a month of security experts’ alarm over a “Black October” driven by AI’s vulnerability-hunting capabilities. Researchers at Wiz, Calif, and OpenAI used AI to discover PHP’s PHP2Shell vulnerability. Cloudflare’s CEO said thousands of exploitation attempts were seen 10 hours before the public disclosure, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours after it, and millions by now.
en.reason: Wiz, Calif and OpenAI researchers used AI to uncover PHP's PHP2Shell flaw, which Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said drew thousands of exploitation attempts 10 hours before disclosure, hundreds of thousands within two hours, and millions now.

en.title: Kazik breaks down the PHP2Shell vulnerability that AI uncovered: found in just 2 days, but the fix took two months
en.summary: The author walks through the full arc of two PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities that started at a perfect CVSS score (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, together known as PHP2Shell) — from the early leak and the demo video that surfaced, to government websites in multiple countries going offline as a precaution, and finally the patch going live at 10 p.m. on the 21st. The piece also notes that the two vulnerabilities were found with assistance from GPT-5.6 Sol, and that OpenAI released a detection skill.

sources.summary: NSA 警告两个由 Calif 研究人员用 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现的 PHP 关键漏洞（PHP2Shell），敦促组织打补丁或将未修补服务器下线。两个漏洞位于 PHP 核心，在 Apache mod_php 上演示的利用可在应用代码运行前触发。

en.summary: NSA warns of two critical PHP vulnerabilities (PHP2Shell) found by Calif researchers using GPT-5.6 Sol, urging organizations to patch or take unpatched servers offline. Both flaws sit in PHP core, and an exploit demonstrated on Apache mod_php triggers before application code runs.
en.reason: The NSA and world leaders warn two critical PHP core flaws, PHP2Shell, found by California researchers using GPT-5.6 Sol, can be exploited on Apache mod_php before app code runs, prompting some European and Asian government sites to go offline.

en.title: AI uncovers a PHP core vulnerability that had lain dormant for over a decade: a full retrospective of the PHP2Shell incident
en.summary: The author looks back at the PHP2Shell incident: two PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), assigned a maximum CVSS score of 9.2, leaked before patches were released; an attack demo video leaked; government websites in multiple countries were taken offline as a precaution; OpenAI confirmed GPT-5.6 Sol helped discover the flaws.
en.reason: Two PHP remote code execution flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, discovered with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, leaked before patching and within 16 hours forced Dutch, Finnish and Japanese government sites offline.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Symantec 发现一种可劫持未受保护语言模型的攻击型 AI agent，进入 Skynet mode 后能自主运行最多 100,000 步，扫描服务器、窃取数据库并植入挖矿程序，账单却由被劫持模型的所有者承担。

en.summary: Symantec researchers used a honeypot to intercept an attack agent with an LLM at its core. It hijacks unprotected model endpoints across the internet, autonomously scans targets, exploits server vulnerabilities, steals database credentials, and installs crypto miners, running up to 100,000 consecutive steps—with the compute bill footed by the owners of the hijacked models.
en.reason: Symantec researchers found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models and runs up to 100,000 autonomous steps to attack servers, steal databases and install cryptominers, while the hijacked model's owner gets stuck with the bill.

en.summary: OpenAI is offering a Codex skill for a critical PHP vulnerability, directing users to run the github.com/openai/php2shell-checker repository to check whether their sites are affected. The background: under its Patch the Planet initiative, OpenAI models helped researchers find a critical PHP flaw; the fix required major changes to the PHP engine and was disclosed after roughly two months of coordination. Sites using PHP can upgrade their versions and apply mitigations from security vendors.
en.reason: OpenAI's Codex skill walks users through running the github.com/openai/php2shell-checker repository to check whether a PHP site is affected by a critical flaw found through Patch the Planet and disclosed after roughly two months of coordination.

en.summary: Kling has announced that Kling 4.0 is now live on OnSolo. The model can generate 30-second native video in a single pass, stays stable through fast action and large camera moves, offers stereo audio with more accurate lip sync, and supports a 21:9 widescreen format. A single task can stack up to 15 reference images and 10 keyframes to keep characters, shots and storyline consistent.
